F.abstract.conclusion_sentence.value: In this link-unit-month analysis of routine HMIS data from India, April 2012 to February 2020, the results were consistent with higher stillbirth rates after third-trimester heat, full-gestation rainfall deficit or an El Niño gestation (third-trimester heat); and not consistent with a higher low birth weight share among weighed newborns after full-gestation heat, rainfall deficit or an El Niño gestation.
